name: Link
intent: Inline text that takes people somewhere: a record, a list or another page.
usage: Use Link for text that navigates, inside a sentence or as a value, like a ledger number, a parent account or View recent invoices. It is one component: children is the text, href is where it goes. It takes the size of the text around it. tone brand is the blue that says this is a link; neutral is for links inside quiet text and keeps an underline. external opens it in a new tab and adds the new-tab mark. Without href it acts in place, as a button that looks like a link, like opening a tab on the same page. disabled shows it in faint text that goes nowhere. For a column of links use LinkList; for a link in a table use a link Cell; for anything that changes data use Button. See contracts/link.json for the full contract.

children.note: The link text. Say where it goes, like Parent Co or View recent invoices, not Click here.

href.note: Where the link goes. Leave it out and the link is a button that acts in place.

onClick.note: Runs on click. Without href it is the link's whole job.

tone.note: brand is link blue, underlined on hover. neutral is body text grey with an underline, for links inside quiet text.

external.note: Opens in a new tab, with the new-tab mark after the text.

disabled.note: Faint text that goes nowhere and cannot be focused.

useWhen: A value that opens its record, like a ledger number or a parent account.
A link inside a sentence or a notice.
doNot: Do not use Link for an action that changes data, like Delete or Save. Use Button.
Do not use Link in a table cell. Use a link Cell.
Do not stack Links into a list yourself. Use LinkList.
Do not write Click here or More; the text says where it goes.
a11y: A real a element with href, or a button when it acts in place, so the keyboard and screen readers treat it for what it does.
A visible focus ring in the brand outline.
external adds opens in a new tab for screen readers, and rel noopener.
Neutral links keep an underline, so colour is not the only sign of a link.
